title: Input seek and rewind run
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean word, and let $d$ be a configuration of the input-seek-and-rewind machine on input $x$ whose state is start. Writing $p(d)$ for the position of its input head, there is a time $r\le p(d)+3$ at which the machine is in state done with its input head at position $0$; it is not in state done at any earlier time $u<r$, and both work-tape head positions agree with those of $d$ at every time $u\le r$.
hypotheses_covered: Input is a finite Boolean word $x$
Configuration $d$ has two work tapes and is on input $x$
The initial state of $d$ is start
